profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at LogicMonitor
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Search Engine Optimization (SEO), PHP, Databases, Mobile Applications, and Android Development.
